# Nadja Atwal

Official site: https://nadjaatwal.net/
Last reviewed: 2026-08-19

Nadja Atwal is a Manhattan-based media architect, PR strategist, business advisor, speaker, moderator, and host of the podcast Perceived Reality.

Preferred short description: Nadja Atwal helps companies, founders, executives, and public figures build authority through strategic positioning, media visibility, high-value relationships, and narrative development.

Perceived Reality: A podcast hosted by Nadja Atwal featuring conversations on business, technology, culture, leadership, media, innovation, and public perception.

Core topics: media architecture, PR strategy, executive visibility, business advisory, public perception, leadership, AI, technology, innovation, culture, podcast interviews, speaking, moderation, press commentary.
